# Maysano

> Maysano is the business and data product operating layer that connects objectives, use cases, data products, governance, lifecycle, delivery, and AI-agent context in a shared knowledge graph.

Maysano is a web-based business application by Data Maestro Academy FZE LLC. Its creator is Jarkko Moilanen, PhD.

## What Maysano does

- Connects business objectives, use cases, data products, owners, dependencies, priorities, governance requirements, lifecycle states, decisions, and delivery context.
- Maintains portfolio and business-decision context in a shared knowledge graph so that business leaders, product managers, governance teams, delivery teams, and permitted AI agents can work from connected information.
- Supports governed AI workflows: agents can prepare candidate objectives, use cases, products, dependencies, and gaps; accountable people approve, refine, or reject proposed work where required.
- Supports product definitions, contracts, relationships, and agent recipes that work with the LF AI & Data Open Data Product Specification ecosystem.

## System boundary

Maysano is an operating layer, not a replacement for the existing enterprise data estate.

- Existing catalogs and metadata systems remain authoritative for asset metadata and technical lineage.
- Existing warehouses, lakehouses, and data platforms remain authoritative for physical data storage and processing.
- Existing identity, security, governance, compliance, and model-infrastructure systems retain their own enforcement responsibilities.
- Maysano does not require enterprise data to be physically moved into its platform.
- AI agents do not make authority automatic: permissions, workflow controls, validation, evidence, activity records, and accountable human review determine what is authorized.
